oracle.statement: for one unchanged collection: (R1) two consecutive cluster-info reads return identical (peer_id, shard_count); (R2) cluster-info shard_count == describe_collection result.config.params.shard_number (contract-declared integer, two documented views of the same quantity); (R3) cluster-info peer_id == cluster_status result.peer_id (this-peer identity on both cluster faces); any relation mismatch is Type4_StateLogicViolation (constraint qdrant_type_cluster_collection_info_001)
